metadata.title: Email SMTP and DNS
metadata.subject: NCC — Net-Centric Computing
metadata.contentType: Original practice based on the accompanying lecture notes

source.section: Section 5 — DNS and the destination mail server

questions.sentence: The DNS record type for mail exchangers is ___.
questions.explanation: MX identifies mail exchanger hostnames and preferences.

source.section: Section 5 — DNS and the destination mail server

questions.sentence: A mail exchanger preference of 10 is preferred over 20 because the ___ number has higher priority.
The SMTP envelope recipient command is ___.
hints: Two words, not a visible message header.
questions.explanation: RCPT TO names an envelope recipient.

questions.sentence: The SMTP command that starts the reverse-path part of a mail transaction is ___.
hints: Two words introducing the sender path.
questions.explanation: MAIL FROM begins the mail transaction envelope.

questions.sentence: The reply code asking for message content after DATA is ___.
questions.explanation: 354 permits the client to send DATA content.

source.section: Section 4 — Email architecture and message structure

questions.sentence: Server-to-server SMTP normally uses TCP port ___; message submission normally uses port ___.
questions.explanation: Relay and submission are distinct service roles.

source.section: Section 4 — Email architecture and message structure

questions.sentence: Implicit TLS message submission uses port ___.
hints: The TLS handshake comes before the SMTP greeting.

questions.sentence: SMTP lines in these examples end with ___, represented by hexadecimal 0d 0a.
questions.explanation: The application framing includes both control bytes.

source.section: Section 5 — DNS and the destination mail server

questions.sentence: The DNS record for an IPv6 exchanger address is ___.
questions.explanation: AAAA maps a name to an IPv6 address.

questions.sentence: A 4xx SMTP reply broadly indicates a ___ failure.
hints: A later retry can be meaningful.
questions.explanation: Temporary and permanent replies have different retry implications.

source.section: Section 4 — Email architecture and message structure

questions.sentence: ___ describes message media types, multipart bodies, and transfer encodings.
hints: The Internet mail content extension family.
questions.explanation: MIME structures content; it does not provide TCP reliability.

questions.sentence: After STARTTLS succeeds, the SMTP client sends ___ again.
questions.explanation: Earlier capability knowledge is discarded after TLS negotiation.
